protocol.orders: Historicalresearch/paper only; no real broker executions, deposits, challenges or payouts

portfolio.risk_note: R denominator is allocated budget. Integer quantities and cash cap lower exposure; fees/gaps can exceed allocated stop budget. No literal historical split-adjusted share claim.

qualification.static_rule_replay: Descriptive loss floors only; not exact firm and not a payout

rules.rsi2_pullback_5: Long/cash only. Prior closed daily close>SMA200 and Wilder RSI2<5 enter next open. Exit next open after prior close>SMA5. Fixed3ATR14 protection added by this project; no TP, no trailing, no short, no same-close fills or averaging down. Equality neither triggers entry nor indicator exit.

protocol.scope: Explicit sequential exploratory test on already viewed ETF history and factors. Not a new independent holdout; no family/threshold/market promotion after outcome. Rules are our fixed hypothesis; source verification limitations are preserved in the source audit.

selection.basis: One fixed family and parameters declared before this performance run; no optimization

fixed_project_adaptations: Strict RSI2<5 replaces source<=10; no threshold search
Long/cash only removes source short branch
Close>SMA5 level exit replaces fresh crossover condition
Protective fixed3ATR14 stop and position risk/cash caps added; no source stop exists
Five equal ETF buckets, risk1.25% current bucket balance, integer shares/gross1x replace90% brokercash
Price-only vendor OHLC/no adjclose/dividend/cashinterest differs from source adjustedclose
RSI both gain/loss0 uses neutral50 rather than source100
Fees/spread/slippage/carry stress and segment-flat resets are project assumptions
Nextopen execution remains causal but exact historical adjusted fills, source model and liquidity are not reproduced

history.limit: Earliest observed added files in project, not date of invention or proof of original Connors publication

source_rules.cost_model: Pinned default broker NoCommission; no documented spread/slippage/funding/news model in this sample
source_rules.exit_cancellation: Resubmit canceled market exit;2015 revision prevents duplicate active exit submissions
source_rules.fill_model: Market orders default onClose=False. Pinned broker processes queued orders before strategy OnBars and fills at next bar adjusted open, subject to model conditions
source_rules.long_exit: Fresh cross above SMA5: previous difference<=0 and current difference>0
source_rules.positions: One tracked long or short; no protective stop/target/time limit/session flatten
source_rules.price_basis: Pinned2014 forces adjusted values and uses adjusted close indicators; later2016 version uses adjusted prices if available
source_rules.rsi_flat_convention: Pinned source returns100 if average loss==0, including both averages0
source_rules.rsi_initialization: RSIEventWindow first average from N changes over N+1 closes, then Wilder recursive gain/loss smoothing
source_rules.short_exit: Fresh cross below SMA5: previous difference>=0 and current difference<0
source_rules.sizing: Integer90% current broker cash/current bar rawClose in pinned2014; not a stop-risk budget
